IS: 10365- 1982 




Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR 

PACKING RING AND HOUSING FOR 

BACK COVER JOINT FOR WATCH CASES 



(Reaffirmed -2012) 



1. Scope — Gives the dimensions of packing rings of following types and their relevant dimensions 
in back cover and bezel for housing. 

Type A Flat type packing suitable for WR-1 type watch case (5ee IS : 10361-1983 'Classi- 
fication of wrist watch cases'). 

Type B — ring type packing suitable for WR-2 and WR-3 type watch cases (5eelS: 
10361-1983).

3. Designation 

3.1 Flat Type Packing — Shall be designated by the dimensions di x d^ x a. 

3.2 0-Ring Type Packing — ShaW be designated by the dimensions dx x d^- 

4. Material for Packing Ring — Nitrile butadiene rubber with shore hardness of 60 to 80 for 
Types A-1 and B and above 80ior Type A-2. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to wrist watch case. 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following: 

NIHS 62-02:1968 Joints toriques — Logements — Pour etanch^ite courante. Normes De 
L'Industrie Horlog^re Suisse. 

NIHS 62-04:1372 Joints plats — Logements — Pour etancheite courante. Normes De 
L'Industrie Horlog^ie Suisse.
